Wähle „Angriff“. Ein Zeiger läuft über d: Choose “Attack”. A pointer runs across the bar: press E or Space when it is in the golden zone; in the red core it lands masterfully. Every attack gives you focus (the pips below) and a little nerve back.
Spieler 2 bestätigt mit Enter (Gamepad A: Player 2 confirms with Enter (gamepad A). Both of you attack once.
Holt holt aus: Ein Ring zieht sich um di: Holt winds up: a ring closes in on you. Press Space when the ring reaches you. Dodging almost always works, but it costs nerves. Once your nerves are gone, you can no longer dodge.
Player 2 dodges with ← (gamepad X). Holt attacks you in turn.
Jetzt parieren: F genau im Moment des Ei: Now parry: F exactly at the moment of impact. The window is tight, but a parry costs nothing. It gives back nerves and focus and strikes at once. Parry every blow of an attack and you launch a riposte.
Unter „Fertigkeiten“ liegen stärkere Sch: Under “Skills” you find stronger strikes. They cost focus, some also nerves. With 2 focus you can use Double strike: two beats in a row. Later, the skills of your pathway join them.
Holt hat dir einen Verband zugeworfen. U: Holt has tossed you a bandage. Under “Items” you can use one thing per turn without ending your turn: bandages heal, tonics steady your nerves, warding salt burns the occult.
„Fliehen“ bringt dich aus fast jedem Kam: “Flee” gets you out of almost any fight. Against elites and bosses you still have to hold out for some rounds afterwards. Not today: put Holt on the mat!
Du bist neu in der Stadt: ein freier Erm:
You are new in town: a freelance investigator whom the Kettlegate police station hires when the constables are at a loss. And lately they often are.

Nobody trusts you here yet. Your reputation with the police decides which files you may read and who talks to you.

Before you may see Inspector Marlowe, Sergeant Holt takes you onto the mat for practice. After that, report to her office at the back on the right.
Ein breiter Mann in Uniform stellt sich:
A broad man in uniform steps into your path. “Sergeant Holt, duty officer. You're the new one? Before you see the Inspector, you step onto the mat with me. Out there everyone carries a knife, and I don't send anyone out who can't defend themselves.”

“I'll call out every step: striking, dodging, parrying, skills, items. At the top of the fight you'll always see what's next.”
Holt wirft dir einen Verband zu. „Den br: Holt tosses you a bandage. “You'll need that in a minute. Start whenever you like.”
Holt dusts off his trousers. “Three more things, then I'll let you go to Marlowe.”

“First: keep your eyes open. With Q you look closer. Some call it Spirit Sight: you see traces no one else sees, and a shimmer around certain people. It wears on your nerves, so not for too long.”

“Second: everything you find and hear goes into your notebook (J). There you link clues until a suspicion holds, and only then do you accuse anyone. Accuse the wrong person and you lose reputation.”
„Drittens, und das bleibt unter uns: In:
“Third, and this stays between us: in this city some people drink potions that change them. They call themselves Beyonders. Whoever drinks such a potion has to digest it by acting the way their pathway demands. Otherwise the unrest eats them alive. If anyone ever offers you a vial like that: read first, then drink.”

“And now off to Inspector Marlowe, office at the back on the right. If you want to practise again, I'm right here.”
Holt stellt sich auf die Matte im Hinter: Holt steps onto the mat in the back yard. “I'll call out every step. What comes next is shown at the top. Don't worry: nobody goes down here until I say so.”
Holt landet auf dem Hosenboden und lacht: Holt lands on his backside and laughs. “There you go. Now you know how it's done. Come on, there's something else I want to tell you.”
